$comment: Single source of the Content-Security-Policy (P1.5). `npm run gen:csp` writes it into public/_headers (HTTP header, applied by Cloudflare) and src/index.html (<meta>, minus the directives a meta policy ignores). `npm run check:csp` fails CI when either file drifts.
script-src never gets 'unsafe-eval' or 'unsafe-inline' (plan section 2, Constraints).

script-src 'wasm-unsafe-eval' is the script sandbox (P3.1): it lets the page compile WebAssembly, which is how the QuickJS engine that runs user scripts is loaded, from the app's own origin. It does not allow eval, new Function or a string given to setTimeout: those stay blocked.
connect-src is open because sending requests to arbitrary user-specified hosts is the app's core feature.
worker-src covers Monaco's workers and the script sandbox worker (the QuickJS engine), both same-origin bundles.

style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' (plan P1.5.16, tested 2026-10-07 without it in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit): Monaco writes style attributes (top/height/width of every line) and a codicon <style> element; Angular adds its component styles as <style> elements and 13 template lines have a static style attribute; the CDK adds its overlay and dialog styles as <style> elements. Monaco alone rules it out, and a static site has no per-response nonce.
Fonts are self-hosted and icons are inline SVG, so no third-party origin appears here.
img-src blob: is the image preview of a response (P2.13): the bytes are in the page already, and the blob's type is one of a fixed list of image types.

frame-src blob: is the HTML preview of a response (P2.13, plan D19): a sandboxed frame with no allow-* token, whose document carries its own policy (default-src 'none'). blob: only, so the frame cannot be navigated to any other address.

frame-ancestors is 'self', not 'none' (plan D25, maintainer, 2026-10-10): a blob: document inherits this policy, and WebKit applies the inherited frame-ancestors to the preview frame itself, so 'none' left the preview blank in Safari. No other origin can frame the app; e2e/viewers.spec.ts asserts both.
